settle: Income and race drive tree planting history, building form, AC and ED use together, and 54 districts cannot separate them. Three designs would: (1) within-neighbourhood variation, e.g. block-level canopy and residence-level heat illness from individual records; (2) MillionTreesNYC (2007-2015) planting timing as an instrument, comparing blocks planted early and late (Forestry Tree Points hn5i-inap carries planteddate) against later heat ED visits, with the caveat that planting targeted high-HVI areas; (3) a daily case-crossover of heat ED visits by ZCTA with canopy as an effect modifier, which compares each area with itself.
